scope: Batch 1: core-crypto, invoice-schema, address-safety, qr-exchange, secret-box. Pending next worker: ux-vault portable runtime (nonportable paths retained for exclusion decision), web scannerCore and worker. KeyVault/keystore owned by custody lane; manifest/deployment owned by payments lane.
constraints: No target execution or exploit reproduction
method: git show immutable objects plus GitHub fetch_file at pinned SHA during workspace reset; associated tests inspected as code only, not executed
coverage_semantics: Full read at candidate also covers base when blobs are identical. Different base blobs require delta inspection; no changed base full read implied.

observations.title: Secret storage APIs are best-effort guardrails
observations.detail: copyOf copies then zeroes source by default on successful return; take transfers ownership without zeroing. Validation failures before copy do not consume input. Same-realm isolation and guaranteed zeroization are not claimed.

observations.title: Known key-compartment relationship is explicitly recorded
observations.detail: Viewing-key delegation combined with one-time private-key export has a documented master-spend confidentiality consequence. It is already known/tested in candidate, not a newly discovered primitive break. Custody lane notified. No recovery steps supplied.

observations.title: Invoice verification and seller identity are separate
observations.detail: Default parsed result can carry invalid signature; policy gate must reject it. Required-pin mode rejects invalid/unpinned results; caller supplies intended seller pin set. Passphrase prompt header is unauthenticated.

observations.title: Minimal receipt recipient binding is conditional
observations.detail: Receipt is a seller attestation and field-consistency check, not independent payment proof. New optional stealthAddress means an absent address does not assert recipient binding even when caller supplies expectation. Intentional tested semantics; payments lane notified to assess UI claims.
observations.integration_followup: payments_network_review confirmed correct seller-attestation labels and conditional recipient display, but will record a low candidate wording mismatch in en.json:973 where introduction promises prepared-recipient comparison even for minimal receipts.

observations.title: QR integrity does not authenticate sender
observations.detail: Bounded single-session reassembly validates canonical data and digest prefix; sender trust comes from decoded application payload. Accepted duplicates intentionally refresh inactivity timer. No integrity bypass established.

observations.title: Address-safety docs contain stale dependency statements
observations.detail: README/DEVIATIONS describe Node-only node:crypto hashing, while actual implementation uses noble SHA-256. Documentation maintenance only; do not use this stale text to exclude package from browser scope.

known_changes.title: Base64url runtime type guard
known_changes.classification: low-impact public-API hardening; no direct browser exploit established
known_changes.comparison: runtime blob identical to candidate; only regression test unused argument differs
known_changes.impact: Non-string programmatic input now yields fixed Base64UrlError. Fragment entry already checks string type.

known_changes.title: Dense data-array canonicalization
known_changes.impact: Rejects sparse/decorated/accessor arrays and snapshots data properties before recursion. Imported strict JSON cannot encode JavaScript getters/proxies, so no external payload reachability established.

known_changes.title: Merchant-profile invalid-clock rejection
known_changes.impact: Non-finite and negative injected clocks no longer bypass expiry comparison. No externally controlled clock path established.

known_changes.title: Rejected QR conflict preserves inactivity deadline
known_changes.comparison: assembler implementation and tests identical to candidate
known_changes.impact: Rejected conflicting input no longer refreshes partial-session activity. It did not bypass final payload integrity; web conflict path resets assembly.

known_changes.title: Precise verification failure classes
known_changes.impact: Missing signatures, unsupported versions and unavailable local crypto are classified separately; no relaxed success path observed.

known_changes.title: Minimal receipts
known_changes.impact: Allows signed receipts omitting one-time address; conditional recipient binding is explicit in tests and must remain explicit in UI.
